info.title: Traigent Backend Agent Compliance Evidence Routes
info.description: Read-only, project-scoped evidence-coverage view of one Agent (AGB-74 slice 1). Ships dark behind an operator flag: while the flag is off the route answers the standard not-found envelope as if it did not exist.

get.summary: Get an Agent's compliance evidence coverage
get.description: Viewer-level read over the same Agent scope as the readiness detail. Tenant and project come only from the authenticated context. An Agent invisible in the authorized scope (unknown, foreign or archived) and a deployment with the feature off both return the same generic readiness 404. The response is an evidence inventory, not a determination.

404.description: Agent not found in the authorized project scope, or the feature is off

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.
